common.vitest: Exactly one named selected callback passes; zero failed/unhandled/runtime error suites. Skips are recorded, not counted executed.
common.reportTransport: Parse JSON observation records from retained stdout, preserving raw log hash. No new BDP output environment or file report assumed.
common.binding: Each report exact entry realpath/hash and declared source equal fresh consumer provenance/final clean candidate; workspaceDirty false, binding.served installedPayloadDigest equals independently reproduced full dependency payload; sourceCommit/fixtureDigest/profile/scope/authorityMode and exact twelve operationTargets validated; cryptographic identity fields nonempty lowercase64hex. Do not require different fixture configurations or random credential identities to be equal across independent launches. Reopen sameness is asserted within source.
common.cleanup: All reported children exited0/no signal, independent fresh ps absence; supervisor process-group and sampled PID absence, no forced kill/timeouts/errors, no runtime roots in union of sampled-still-present and final TMP listing. Preserve unknown nonruntime entries and classify Node caches. Entry/consumer/archive/source before-after hashes exact.

minimum-positive.label: private-installed-minimum-receiving
minimum-positive.responseRows: Exact22 ordinal/label/method/url/credential-role/body fingerprints/field occurrence counts against frozen requests and actual issued receipt roots/pages. Bodyless response hashes independently equal SHA256(empty); receiving400 headers must omit tuple/validator/location/link/development-limit, HEAD body0 and matching GET representation length. Exact status vector retained.
minimum-positive.directory: Actual reported directory absent independently, not only boolean.
minimum-positive.bodyEvidence: Full body/schema/receipt/result/resource/Problem equality occurs inside callback; retained response hashes cannot reconstruct full body or prove extra assertions by themselves.

snapshot-capacity.label: private-installed-snapshot
snapshot-capacity.responseRows: Require each actual method/url/status/body-octets/wireSha256 record; fixed routes match canonical scope; generated retained Snapshot IDs must be actual observed URLs. Source assertions establish nonallocation and reopen persistence; no response-body reconstruction from hashes.
snapshot-capacity.directory: Not included in snapshot report. Absence must come from dedicated supervisor TMP inventories and sampled runtime roots.

snapshot-fresh.label: private-installed-snapshot
snapshot-fresh.responseRows: Exact31 status/method/order; current/retained/future/foreign/partial tuples, retained bodies and final state are asserted in callback. Source does not emit a context header ledger; do not invent one from wire hashes.
snapshot-fresh.directory: As capacity: external dedicated TMP inventory required.

reject: Any missing/duplicate report, other observation label, generic failure, mismatched selection/status/count/binding, truncated record, surviving child/store or cleanup error. No expected-negative exit is accepted in these three positive cohorts.
